text: I wanted a simple habit tracker with a widget in my homescreen similar to GitHub heatmap. I found this one. I like the style and simplicity, but you have to buy the pro version to access the widgets. I did, only to realise that the widgets featured are not the same in Android, with the squares without rounded corners and very bad sizing. I tried to refound the payment, but Google has denied it. I only hope to get the widgets I was promised :(
author: Albert Capdevila
developer_reply: The widget background layout is primarily dependent on the OS skin or launcher you are using, I would suggest you fiddle with the settings a bit and that might fix the issue
